answer_1.quote: We use a T5  model fine-tuned on (q, c, a) triples from Natural Questions, using context passages as input with the answer marked with special tokens. We use the trained model to generate questions (q 1 , q 2 , . . . q k ) for each of the the retrieved set of alternate contexts and answers, ((c 1 , a 1 ), (c 2 , a 2 ), . . . (c k , a k )).

answer_2.quote: We quantify correctness in the generated dataset by manually annotating a samples of 100 (q , c , a ) triples (see Appendix B). The proportion of noise varies from 30% before noise filtering and 25% after noise filtering using an ensemble of models ( §3.4).

answer_4.quote: We manually annotate a subset of 100 generated questions, and find that 96% of these are fluent.
